content: 2:1-4 In misir gari big igo munon qei wurimusub igorun

An Munon inubersiau tari wot igub igoumon end an nonoguret igoumon qiyo? Ne gor wo antoubar igo end oau mein igoumon qiyo? Ne gor Igomurur anmuaserama igoumon qiyo? End ne an munon qei wuribanamsi wuritoubar igoumon qiyo?
An ende ebet igo gab eng ye gor ende yesiari ubereribam. Qomon ete igo end: Oau ne misir gari big ne qibanamsi igamau eng.
An aninomit qas igub munon qei wuri pesuimau eng wagar. Aninomi bumai wogub munon qei wuribererimar.
Ne gor aninou mind qiyo mi qei-qei musub qoat igoumon gas ende munon qei wurinomi eng gor ende at qoatar igoarar.
2:5-11 Yisas wonomi bumaiamor end Qenu bemeniamorei
An Yisas Munon inubersiau tari wonou misir gas ende at qib igoarar.
Yisas wo gor Qenu iitari, ego wo wonomi duet wonou ur gas ende qiribiten igorib misir me igau.
Boru bigan burab wogub munangit qomon eng mom toaterei. Toat ne wau unebi mom warurei.
Munon gamir eng mom munangit warub wogub ne wonomi bumai wogub Qenu qob qamara toat igoai. Isi yarab mom nam tenori big waramari uminer ari qen eng gab umor eng.
Qanam end ne Qenu bemenima erer qite irer eng. Iroa unum ger bo bigor eng unum gugum wuritanamima.
Unum Yisas bigor end munon Qenu ginamt igour eng ne ag e igour eng ne ai erobon qumo igour eng gugum Yisas unum ba ereri ne menmant end gamaur wat bugombour.
Ende at ne Yisas unum ba dibes ete at dibes qomorunor: Yisas Munon inubersiau tari ininou Munon Aib. Ende abari Qenu ininou Tain wonou unum qiribiten igoriner.
2:12-18 Ininou qomon eng urut begen gas ende igoriner

Io, an yonou munon banam, qoan qenen aninob igo qob qemerine toat igoumon gas ende see gor qob mugen aninob quraum eng ende toat igorunon eng sig uber ar. Qenu qo anqubeiamor end an wot yari ne wot oau naget sarau qeretut nob baab igo qen geret bebereg igorunon end qamar end igoruboumon.
Qenu wo anopuri ten igama sarau ebet igoumon. Wo oau anmenima sarau obounon eng wonou iitari obouboumon.
Sarau baab qiyo, a qomon gugum ebet eng agunub qiyo a qi merimisab eng aba wagar.
Ende ebet igorunon eng Qenu magqurt wonou Wau uber me igorunanei.

Igo ne bebereg igamau qob eng igub an urut begen gas ende begent munon ai qent e qomon qoregen wogub qomon boru at qib igour eng wurit ariramari gubour. Ende at igamari Munon Aib bo igeser deriner qen end ye uberet ete misir igibam: Ye sarau ebetem eng ar isi me isau, mi git gaum an, ende qemeribam.
Aninou oau apand eng Qenut mian iset bigau gas ende. End yonou oau apand end yanamari qeru wain ya gas ende isiner eng sig uber, ye mismisiribam. An gugum antoubar ne mismisiribam.
Eng gas ende an gor ye yetoubet ne mismisirar.
2:19-24 Pol Timoti imurimine Pilipai is qamb misir igoai
Munon Aib wonou Timoti anit imurimin qamb qamara gab eng qen piten anit imurimbam. Imurimine isub an maigas igoumon qi eng animbag wogub diab yonob qamara igub ubereribam.
Munon ger Timoti wo gas ende ue, wo gari yenogursi igo ne an musierib qamb qenen anit igub igo.
Munon irou wurinomi qas musub igour. Yisas Munon inubersiau tari wonou sarau eng musub oboub qamb me wuritrab igo.
End an Timoti wonou qomon eng an qoyam eng, wo munon uber. Wo wau ger wonou ur nob sarau baab igo gas ende ye nob Qenu qob qamb qib igoun.
End wo anit imurimbam qen pi. End wo imurimine isa ye maigas ebeini qi eng imbig gab.
Ye Munon Aib wot oabigoum, wonou werei ger yiimbiga eng ye gor anit yaribam.
2:25-30 Pol Epaproditus imurimine Pilipai is qamb misir igoai
Ininou munon banam Epaproditus eng, qoan an yet imurimari diab yenob sarau baab igo ombur naget munon qei wurinob yogamin eng munon eng gor imurimine anit isiner qamb misir igoum.
Wo toar wab igama qob toau isa igumon end oau quguraget animbegeib qamb oau biriberi nub igo.
Apand, wo toar wara qeembes umor ego Qenu toubet musia uberetarei. Wo uma ye qugurau aib yemuaserembar eng gab ye gor yetoubet munon eng musia uberetarei.
End ne ye wo bo imurimine isa an gab oau pomaimotarar qamb misir igoum. Ne gor wo isa an geari ne ye quguraget igoum eng bais mein buriba.
Wo isa an Munon Aib unumut mismisir ba qubei nob igoarar. Munon ende gas eng an unum bererimar.
An yenob Munon inubersiau tari wonou sarau maigas me ubunei eng gab wo sarau eng ebeib qamb wonomi dui dier end qinam umorei.
